snapshot.boundary: This registry is a reproducible offline snapshot of selected primary sources. It is not a claim that an installed framework version is current or that a project has enforced every rule.

zh-CN.title: 软件设计与变更验证
practices: 每个模块承担一个内聚的业务职责，并公开小而明确的公共契约。
在应用边界编排流程；界面、传输、持久化和领域策略不得任意相互依赖。
选择满足已确认需求的最小变更；没有当前用途和负责人时，不添加扩展点、抽象或基础设施。
复用已验证的项目能力，避免创建重复的客户端、授权路径或数据访问封装。
每次行为变更都添加或更新最小有效验证，并运行受影响项目命令和 aicg check。
verification: 对变更模块运行针对性的行为测试或类型检查。
生成治理产物或更新技能后，运行 aicg check .。
记录未运行的命令和剩余边界，不作无证据的完成声明。
boundaries: 这些治理原则不能替代官方框架规范。
生成的技能仅声明指引，不能证明代码库已自动实现低耦合或完整测试。

standards.title: Software design and change verification
practices: Give each module one cohesive business responsibility and expose a small explicit public contract.
Keep orchestration at the application boundary; do not let UI, transport, persistence, and domain policy depend on each other indiscriminately.
Prefer the smallest change that meets a confirmed requirement. Do not add extension points, abstractions, or infrastructure without a current use and owner.
Reuse a verified project capability instead of creating a parallel client, authorization path, or data-access wrapper.
For every behavior change, add or update the narrowest useful verification and run the affected project command plus aicg check.
verification: Run a focused behavior test or type check for the changed module.
Run aicg check . after governance generation or a Skill update.
Record commands not run and the remaining boundary instead of claiming completion.
boundaries: These are governance principles, not a substituted official framework specification.
A generated Skill states guidance; it is not proof that a codebase is automatically low-coupled or fully tested.

zh-CN.title: React 组件纯度与副作用边界
practices: 保持渲染逻辑纯净：相同的 props、state 和 context 必须产生相同结果。
渲染期间不得修改 props、state、context 或非局部值。
用户引起的副作用放在事件处理器中，与外部系统的同步放在 Effects 中，并限制其作用范围。
当独立状态、数据加载或业务策略形成独立变更原因时，拆分组件。
verification: 使用项目测试执行器验证受影响交互以及加载和错误状态。
若项目具备类型检查或构建命令，则执行它们。
boundaries: 应用特定版本 API 前，确认已安装的 React 版本。
客户端校验可改善可用性，但不能替代服务端授权或校验。

standards.title: React component purity and effect boundaries
practices: Keep render logic pure: identical props, state, and context must produce the same result.
Do not mutate props, state, context, or non-local values while rendering.
Put user-caused effects in event handlers and synchronization with external systems in Effects; keep effects narrowly scoped.
Split a component when independent state, data loading, or business policy gives it a separate reason to change.
verification: Exercise the affected interaction and loading/error state with the project test runner.
Run the project type check or build when it exists.
boundaries: Confirm the installed React version before applying version-specific APIs.
Client validation improves usability but does not replace server authorization or validation.

zh-CN.title: Mantine 界面组合与表单边界
practices: 重复的视觉决策优先使用组件 API 和共享主题；重复或复杂样式移入局部 CSS 模块或主题扩展。
不要将内联样式属性作为功能的主要样式系统。
每个表单都应具备有类型的值模型、明确的校验错误、等待状态，以及唯一的提交副作用负责人。
取消或替换过期的异步字段校验，并以服务端校验为准。
verification: 测试无效、有效、等待和重复提交的表单路径。
检查变更控件的键盘操作和可见错误反馈。
boundaries: Mantine 描述界面行为，不验证服务端业务规则。
确认已安装 Mantine 版本对样式导入的要求。

standards.title: Mantine UI composition and form boundaries
practices: Prefer component APIs and a shared theme for repeated visual decisions; move repeated or complex styling into local CSS modules or theme extensions.
Do not use inline style props as the primary styling system for a feature.
Give each form a typed value model, explicit validation errors, pending state, and one owner for submission side effects.
Cancel or supersede stale asynchronous field validation and keep server validation authoritative.
verification: Test invalid, valid, pending, and resubmission form paths.
Check keyboard access and visible error feedback for changed controls.
boundaries: Mantine documents UI behavior; it does not validate server-side business rules.
Confirm package style-import requirements for the installed Mantine version.

zh-CN.title: NestJS 模块边界
practices: 每项业务能力建模为功能模块；控制器作为传输适配器，提供者放在模块边界内部。
仅导出构成明确公共接口的提供者，避免将便利提供者变为全局依赖。
授权和用例编排保留在应用服务内，不放入控制器或仓储。
在传输边界执行 DTO 或契约校验，并在返回响应前映射持久化细节。
verification: 通过控制器或应用服务边界测试模块公共行为。
编译 Nest 应用并运行针对性测试命令。
boundaries: 没有项目证据时，不推断多租户、角色或工作流转换。
采用装饰器或平台集成前，确认已安装 NestJS 主版本的指引。

standards.title: NestJS module boundaries
practices: Model each business capability as a feature module with controllers as transport adapters and providers behind the module boundary.
Export only the providers that form a deliberate module public interface; avoid turning convenience providers into global dependencies.
Keep authorization and use-case orchestration in application services, not in controllers or repositories.
Use DTO or contract validation at the transport boundary and map persistence details before returning a response.
verification: Test the module public behavior through its controller or application service boundary.
Compile the Nest application and run its focused test command.
boundaries: Do not infer multi-tenancy, roles, or workflow transitions without project evidence.
Confirm installed NestJS major-version guidance before adopting decorators or platform integrations.

zh-CN.title: Fastify 请求与响应契约
practices: 为路由参数、查询、请求头和请求体定义输入模式；模式是可信应用代码，不是用户输入。
公共端点使用响应模式，确保仅序列化预期字段。
初始校验保持同步且不查询数据库；异步授权或查找放在适当的后续生命周期钩子。
返回稳定且有文档说明的错误，不泄露内部校验或实现细节。
verification: 测试路由的畸形输入、未授权输入和意外字段。
测试序列化响应不包含敏感或内部字段。
boundaries: 模式校验不能替代授权、幂等性或工作流状态约束。
选择插件或生命周期 API 前，确认 Fastify 和 Nest 平台适配器版本。

standards.title: Fastify request and response contracts
practices: Define input schemas for route parameters, query, headers, and bodies; treat schemas as trusted application code, never as user input.
Use response schemas for public endpoints so only intended fields are serialized.
Keep initial validation synchronous and free of database calls; perform asynchronous authorization or lookups in the appropriate later lifecycle hook.
Return stable, documented errors without leaking internal validation or implementation details.
verification: Test malformed input, unauthorized input, and unexpected fields for the route.
Test that sensitive or internal response fields are absent from the serialized response.
boundaries: Schema validation is not authorization, idempotency, or workflow-state enforcement.
Confirm Fastify and Nest platform adapter versions before selecting plugins or lifecycle APIs.

zh-CN.title: 关键 API 完整性、幂等性与重放防护
practices: 添加控制前，根据业务影响识别关键写端点；每次此类请求均由服务端强制授权和工作流状态转换。
可由外部重试的写入必须幂等：将幂等键绑定到已认证主体、操作和规范化请求标识；原子保留首次结果，拒绝同一键对应不同请求。
威胁模型要求端到端请求完整性时，明确签名覆盖组件、允许算法、密钥解析、创建与过期窗口和验证错误；不得自创签名格式。
对重放敏感请求，按操作需要在服务端执行有限有效窗口及一次性或幂等状态；不得信任前端保证顺序。
不得将秘密和签名放在 URL 中，并从日志中脱敏。
verification: 测试有效请求、签名组件被篡改、过期请求以及重放或重复请求。
测试并发重复提交仅产生一次业务效果，并返回明确的重复响应。
测试服务端拒绝无效或乱序的状态转换。
boundaries: 不默认给所有端点添加消息签名；先记录威胁模型和密钥生命周期。
幂等存储时长、规范化和响应语义是需要负责人确认的产品决策。

standards.title: Critical API integrity, idempotency, and replay resistance
practices: Classify a write endpoint as critical from its business impact before adding controls; enforce authorization and workflow-state transitions on the server for every such request.

Make externally retryable writes idempotent: bind an idempotency key to authenticated subject, operation, and a canonical request identity; atomically retain the first outcome and reject key reuse with a different request.

When end-to-end request integrity is required by the threat model, define an explicit signature profile with covered components, permitted algorithms, key resolution, creation/expiry window, and verifier errors; do not invent an ad-hoc signing format.
For replay-sensitive requests, enforce a bounded validity window and one-time or idempotent server-side state appropriate to the operation; never trust the frontend to enforce ordering.
Keep secrets and signatures out of URLs and redact them from logs.
verification: Test a valid request, an altered signed component, an expired request, and a replay or duplicate request.
Test concurrent duplicate submissions produce one business effect and a defined repeat response.
Test invalid or out-of-order state transitions are rejected by the server.
boundaries: Do not add message signatures to every endpoint by default; document the threat model and key lifecycle first.
Idempotency storage duration, canonicalization, and response semantics are product decisions that require an owner.

zh-CN.title: Drizzle 数据访问与事务边界
practices: 查询构造和持久化映射应位于单个模块负责的仓储或数据访问边界内。
仅将必须共同成功或失败的数据库变更放入事务；尽可能将外部网络调用放在事务外。
在用例中明确传递事务句柄，不隐式开启嵌套且不相关的工作单元。
使用数据库约束和冲突处理保证并发正确性，不仅依赖事前读取。
verification: 测试多步写入失败时的回滚。
针对相关唯一约束或状态约束，测试重复和并发写入。
boundaries: 根据有文档记录的业务不变量选择隔离级别和重试行为，不套用通用默认值。
Drizzle 事务支持取决于已安装的数据库驱动及版本。

standards.title: Drizzle data access and transaction boundaries
practices: Keep query construction and persistence mapping in a repository or data-access boundary owned by one module.
Wrap only the database changes that must succeed or fail together in a transaction; keep external network calls outside the transaction when possible.
Pass the transaction handle through the use case explicitly instead of silently starting nested, unrelated units of work.
Use database constraints and conflict handling for correctness that must hold under concurrency; do not rely only on a prior read.
verification: Test rollback on a failing multi-step write.
Test duplicate and concurrent writes against the relevant unique or state constraint.
boundaries: Choose isolation level and retry behavior from a documented business invariant, not from a generic default.
Drizzle transaction support depends on the installed database driver and version.

zh-CN.title: PostgreSQL 并发不变量
practices: 为关键操作选择锁、约束、隔离级别或重试策略前，先明确并发不变量。
适当使用唯一约束、条件更新和行锁，避免正确性依赖读写时序。
选定隔离级别可能产生序列化失败或冲突时，明确处理这些结果。
将序列值视为标识符，不作为可回滚业务事件或无间隙计数器。
verification: 运行试图违反不变量的并发测试。
在真实的 PostgreSQL 兼容测试环境验证回滚、冲突和重试行为。
boundaries: PostgreSQL 默认值和行为不能替产品决定冲突策略。
生产规模、连接池配置和迁移顺序需要环境专属证据。

standards.title: PostgreSQL concurrency invariants
practices: State the concurrency invariant for a critical operation before choosing locks, constraints, isolation, or retries.
Use unique constraints, conditional updates, and row locking where appropriate so correctness does not depend on timing between reads and writes.
Handle serialization failures or conflict outcomes explicitly when the selected isolation level can produce them.
Treat sequence values as identifiers, not as rolled-back business events or gap-free counters.
verification: Run a concurrent test that attempts to violate the invariant.
Verify rollback, conflict, and retry behavior with the real PostgreSQL-compatible test environment.
boundaries: PostgreSQL defaults and behavior do not decide product conflict policy for you.
Production scale, pool configuration, and migration sequencing need environment-specific evidence.

zh-CN.title: Socket.IO 实时事件契约
practices: 在一个共享边界内定义有版本的事件名称及有类型的载荷和确认契约。
服务端授权房间成员资格，并根据已验证的租户、用户或实体所有权推导房间名；房间不构成客户端授权机制。
需要明确结果的命令使用确认和超时语义；允许客户端重试时，处理器必须幂等。
仅对允许丢失的最新状态信号使用 volatile 事件，不用于必须交付的业务状态。
verification: 测试未授权加入房间和跨租户广播尝试。
测试确认超时、重连、重复命令和事件版本兼容行为。
boundaries: Socket.IO 交付机制不能替代持久化领域事件或可靠任务队列。
多服务器扩展需要明确的适配器和交付语义决策。

standards.title: Socket.IO realtime event contracts
practices: Define versioned event names and typed payload/acknowledgement contracts in one shared boundary.
Authorize room membership on the server and derive room names from validated tenant, user, or entity ownership; rooms are not a client authorization primitive.
Use acknowledgement and timeout semantics for commands that need a known result; make command handlers idempotent if clients can retry.
Use volatile events only for intentionally lossy latest-state signals, never for business state that must be delivered.
verification: Test unauthorized room join and cross-tenant broadcast attempts.
Test acknowledgement timeout, reconnect, duplicate command, and event-version compatibility behavior.
boundaries: Socket.IO delivery does not replace persisted domain events or a durable job queue.
Multi-server scaling needs a deliberate adapter and delivery-semantics decision.

zh-CN.title: LiveKit 令牌与媒体授权边界
practices: 仅在可信后端完成用户与房间成员授权后签发访问令牌；不得向浏览器或移动端暴露 API 秘密。
每个令牌仅具备当前操作所需的最小权限、房间身份和较短有效期。
房间创建、参与者授权和应用业务状态保留在后端领域边界，不信任客户端房间输入。
审计令牌签发，但不记录原始令牌或秘密。
verification: 测试未授权用户无法获取或使用房间令牌。
测试权限缩减、过期令牌拒绝和有效参与者加入路径。
boundaries: LiveKit 权限控制媒体访问，不能替代业务数据的应用层授权。
令牌 TTL、身份格式和房间生命周期必须由产品安全设计负责。

standards.title: LiveKit token and media authorization boundaries
practices: Mint access tokens only on a trusted backend after authorizing the user and room membership; never expose API secrets to a browser or mobile client.
Give each token the minimum grants, room identity, and short validity required for the current operation.
Keep room creation, participant authorization, and application business state in the backend domain boundary rather than trusting client room input.
Audit token issuance without recording raw tokens or secrets.
verification: Test that an unauthorized user cannot obtain or use a room token.
Test reduced grants, expired token rejection, and a valid participant join path.
boundaries: LiveKit grants control media access; they do not replace application-level authorization for business data.
Token TTL, identity format, and room lifecycle must be owned by the product security design.

zh-CN.title: Redis 交付语义与所有权
practices: 根据交付和恢复要求选择 Redis 数据结构，不仅考虑便利性。
仅在可接受断连期间丢失时使用 Pub/Sub；需要重放、恢复或消费组协调时，使用 Streams 等持久机制。
与负责模块共同定义键所有权、TTL、序列化、重试和清理规则。
除非产品明确接受该持久性模型，否则不将 Redis 作为不可逆业务状态的事实来源。
verification: 根据声明的交付保证测试断连、重启、重复和消费者恢复行为。
测试 TTL 或保留策略清理不会删除其他模块的键命名空间。
boundaries: Redis 拓扑、持久化和集群行为需要部署专属验证。
至少一次交付仍要求消费者保持幂等。

standards.title: Redis delivery semantics and ownership
practices: Choose Redis data structures by delivery and recovery requirements, not by convenience.
Use Pub/Sub only when loss during disconnection is acceptable; use a durable mechanism such as Streams when consumers need replay, recovery, or consumer-group coordination.
Define key ownership, TTL, serialization, retry, and cleanup together with the owning module.
Do not treat Redis as the source of truth for irreversible business state unless the product explicitly accepts that durability model.
verification: Test disconnect, restart, duplicate, and consumer recovery behavior for the declared delivery guarantee.
Test TTL or retention cleanup without deleting another module's key namespace.
boundaries: Redis topology, persistence, and cluster behavior require deployment-specific validation.
At-least-once delivery still requires idempotent consumers.

zh-CN.title: BullMQ 幂等任务处理
practices: 确保每个任务可安全运行多次，并聚焦于小型、可观测的工作单元。
根据操作的交付契约选择尝试次数、退避、超时、保留和去重模式；不惯性启用重试。
在业务边界持久化或推导幂等标识，防止重复处理造成重复效果。
区分可重试的暂时故障与永久校验或授权失败，并记录操作人员可见的结果。
verification: 测试重复入队、部分失败后的重试和最终失败路径。
测试保留与去重设置不会无声允许重复业务效果。
boundaries: 仅靠队列重试不能使外部副作用幂等。
生产工作进程并发和可观测性需要明确的运维负责人。

standards.title: BullMQ idempotent job processing
practices: Make each job safe to run more than once and keep one job focused on a small, observable unit of work.
Choose attempts, backoff, timeout, retention, and deduplication mode from the operation's delivery contract; do not enable retries by habit.
Persist or derive an idempotency identity at the business boundary so duplicate processing cannot create duplicate effects.
Separate retryable transient failures from permanent validation or authorization failures and record an operator-visible outcome.
verification: Test duplicate enqueue, retry after a partial failure, and the terminal failure path.
Test that retention and deduplication settings do not silently permit a duplicate business effect.
boundaries: Queue retries alone do not make external side effects idempotent.
Production worker concurrency and observability need operational ownership.
